text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just after entering the Senior Year,
Gold City won a 'Hot Springs Vacation Ticket' in the lottery.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Back then, she was emotionally overwhelmed and refused to go... but she might feel differently now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted her to take a break and rest.
With that intention, I called her over to persuade her, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sounds nice. I want to go to a hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'll check with Mane-G about my days off.
You make sure to submit your schedule too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
You're gonna make me go all by myself?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Mane-G probably wouldn't allow it,
and if that's the case, I don't feel like going either.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If we're going to the hot springs, you're coming with me. That's the condition.
What's it gonna be?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Ahhh. The best.
All my exhaustion just melted away.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: They say this is a hydrogen carbonate spring, so it's supposed to have great skin-cleansing effects.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Isn't my skin totally glowing?
How does it look?
choice_data_list: It's always so sparkling clean that I can't tell...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that's true, but...
What I just said sounded seriously stupid.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "I've been thinking this for a while, but you're like, super into my look, right?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah, I get it.
It's not like I think it's all about looks, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: We've never really had a casual chat like this before, have we?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Wanna go get some fresh air?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—You're wondering why I suddenly
felt like going to the hot springs, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to know
what you really think of me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I've looked so lame up until now, so it'd really tick me off if people got the wrong idea about me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Calling me high-strung, overly harsh,
foul-mouthed... well, you're not wrong."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: “That's just 'cause you're standing way too close. Take a few steps back and look, and I'll look pretty sharp... probably.”
choice_data_list: My impression of you hasn't changed from the beginning until now.
My impression of you hasn't changed since the very beginning.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: Beautiful, strong, and proud—the greatest Uma Musume there is.
Beautiful, strong, and proud—the greatest Uma Musume there is!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Pfft, what's that, you hitting on me?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Normally, that'd be so lame, but...
Well, you're not that kind of person, are you?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's strange. You're not my manager, nor a coworker.
Just what are you to me, I wonder?
choice_data_list: Just an ordinary Trainer, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Then that's just a job title.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well... I see. Being "just a Trainer" is pretty nice, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Someone watching how I run.
...Someone just watching the real me."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
She's not excessively infatuated with me, nor does she just watch from afar;
she's unlike anyone else whose distance is hard to gauge.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No meddling, no assumptions, no pity, and no dissing.
None of that at all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If I hadn't run with you... I think
I never would have come to like myself.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Oops, I'm totally entering monologue mode.
My brain's barely working right now. Is that bad?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You're totally winging it.
...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "It's just my Trainer, so it's fine, I guess..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
with Gold City...
